description: This file contains helper functions for managing CustomResourceDefinitions (CRDs) in Kubernetes, including condition management, version handling, and approval status checks.

methods.name: IsProtectedCommunityGroup
methods.description: Checks if a given group is protected for the Kubernetes community, requiring the approval annotation.

methods.name: GetAPIApprovalState
methods.description: Determines the approval state of an API based on annotations, returning the state and reason.

methods.name: SetCRDCondition
methods.description: Sets or updates a specific condition on a CRD, updating the last transition time.

methods.name: RemoveCRDCondition
methods.description: Removes a specific condition from a CRD.

methods.name: FindCRDCondition
methods.description: Finds and returns a specific condition from a CRD.

methods.name: IsCRDConditionTrue
methods.description: Checks if a specific condition on a CRD is present and true.

methods.name: IsCRDConditionFalse
methods.description: Checks if a specific condition on a CRD is present and false.

methods.name: IsCRDConditionPresentAndEqual
methods.description: Checks if a condition is present and matches a specific status.

methods.name: IsCRDConditionEquivalent
methods.description: Checks if two conditions are equivalent, ignoring timestamps.

methods.name: CRDHasFinalizer
methods.description: Checks if a CRD has a specific finalizer.

methods.name: CRDRemoveFinalizer
methods.description: Removes a specific finalizer from a CRD.

methods.name: HasServedCRDVersion
methods.description: Checks if a specific version is served by the CRD.

methods.name: GetCRDStorageVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the storage version of a CRD.

methods.name: IsStoredVersion
methods.description: Checks if a version is the storage version of the CRD.

methods.name: GetSchemaForVersion
methods.description: Gets the validation schema for a specific CRD version.

methods.name: GetSubresourcesForVersion
methods.description: Gets the subresources for a specific CRD version.

methods.name: HasPerVersionSchema
methods.description: Determines if the CRD uses per-version schemas.

methods.name: HasPerVersionSubresources
methods.description: Determines if the CRD uses per-version subresources.

methods.name: HasPerVersionColumns
methods.description: Determines if the CRD uses per-version additional printer columns.

methods.name: HasVersionServed
methods.description: Checks if a specific version of the CRD is served.
